title: Bounded command execution
responsibility: Runs directly named commands with validated time and output limits, cancellation, controlled inherited environment, and process-group cleanup.

inputs.name: commandEnvironment.extra
inputs.description: Explicit extra child variables, merged after the allowlisted inherited OS variables.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path to invoke directly.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked.args
inputs.description: Argument vector passed directly to the executable.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked.options
inputs.description: Optional cwd, environment, stdin, timeout, combined output limit, cancellation signal and spawn observer.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run.command
inputs.description: Executable name or path to invoke directly.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run.args
inputs.description: Argument vector passed directly to the executable.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run.options
inputs.description: Optional cwd, environment, stdin, timeout, combined output limit, cancellation signal and spawn observer.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync.command
inputs.description: Executable for a synchronous direct probe; only the adapter allowlist of probe command shapes is accepted.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync.args
inputs.description: Direct-probe argument vector, subject to the synchronous command allowlist.

inputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync.options
inputs.description: Optional cwd, environment, stdin, timeout, output limit and abort signal.

outputs.name: commandEnvironment
outputs.description: Environment containing only the allowlisted inherited OS keys plus explicitly supplied extras.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.checked
outputs.description: Stdout bytes when the process exits successfully.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.run
outputs.description: Exit code, stdout bytes and stderr text after bounded execution; timeout, cancellation, launch and output-limit errors reject.

outputs.name: BoundedCommandAdapter.runSync
outputs.description: Exit status and captured stdout/stderr for the direct probe.

errors.name: Command bounds invalid
errors.description: timeout and maxBuffer must be positive finite safe integers no greater than 2147483647
examples: Command bounds must be positive finite integers.

errors.name: Command execution failed
errors.description: execution rejects for launch errors, nonzero checked exits, timeout, cancellation or output overflow

errors.name: Synchronous command not allowed
errors.description: runSync accepts only the direct-probe executable and argument shapes listed by the adapter
examples: Synchronous execution is restricted to direct probes; use run for workloads.
